comment: Complete modern Windows LAPS policy for creating/managing the custom local administrator
account 'x3nc0n' and backing up its password to Entra ID. Retains the existing policy name
and resource type so deployment updates the existing object and preserves assignments.
Replaces the legacy ADMX_AdmPwd Settings Catalog policy; retire that live object separately
only after modern password backup has been verified. Settings from legacy policy roots
are not inherited by the modern LAPS CSP.
These are documented LAPS CSP OMA-URI nodes, avoiding unverified Settings Catalog definition IDs.
Automatic Account Management requires Windows 11 24H2 or later (or Windows Server 2025+).
Older builds do not support automatic account management; do not assume successful creation.
No password is stored in git; Windows LAPS creates/rotates and backs up the secret to Entra ID.
name: laps-account-management
